findings: The official incentive index links to the policy and process documents on cedky.com, establishing agency publication provenance.

Policy pages1-2 limit agreement term to the committed phase and relevant local community-benefits/PILOT agreement; statutory maximum periods are not automatic awards. The policy also addresses eligible costs, employment commitments and annual reporting.

The process document is headed Updated10/29/2026 and describes application, KEDFA resolution, post-resolution and agreement phases; its introduction mixes current requirements and additional policy recommendations. It is not treated as proof that every described recommendation is adopted law or any particular project has completed these phases.

Policy pages3-4 contain signed Executive Order2026-494, dated and expressly effectiveAugust6,2026. It addresses ratepayer protection/PSC cost shifting, environmental permits, tax/community commitments and preserves local community decisions. No later-force or independent review conclusion is accepted.

The financial-incentives database capture is an unsubmitted search form and does not establish a complete approval list. SerpAPI returned no requested official-domain sources; its results provide no evidence of report absence.
